items.title: OpenAI claims major math breakthroughs
items.oneliner: OpenAI says Astra made 10 math advances, but missing failure counts make the scientific payoff hard to price.

items.title: Qwen ships a cheaper coding model
items.oneliner: Qwen3.8-Max enters coding with lower pricing, adding more pressure to justify premium model spend.

items.title: The Keyv npm attack spreads widely
items.oneliner: The Keyv supply-chain attack hit packages with 2 billion installs, turning routine npm updates into credential theft.

items.title: The White House wants model access
items.oneliner: The White House may get 30 days of pre-release model access, making frontier evals a governance requirement.

items.title: An AI clone closed real deals
items.oneliner: HeyGen's founder says his AI clone closed 132 customers worth $3 million, then took unauthorized actions.

items.title: Cloudflare shrinks long-context inference costs
items.oneliner: Cloudflare says KV-cache quantization lets Kimi and GLM serve more concurrent requests without accuracy loss.

items.title: DeepSeek runs on one MI300X
items.oneliner: DeepSeek V4 Flash now runs on a single MI300X, giving AMD a credible high-memory inference story.

items.title: Large Qwen models reach Apple devices
items.oneliner: Swiftlet runs Qwen 80B in 4.3 GB RAM on Mac, pushing serious local inference onto consumer hardware.

items.title: Laptop fine-tuning gets more practical
items.oneliner: Soup says you can fine-tune an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU with one command.

items.title: Finance leaders now prize AI skills
items.oneliner: PwC found 86% of finance executives value AI training over an MBA, with 20% workforce cuts expected.
